initial_build_notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Window title (0): game/main.gd (sets OS window title).
  - Paddle movement, edge clamping, prints (1,2,13,14): game/paddle.gd (movement, velocity, prints).
  - Ball physics, wall rebounds, paddle bounce, spin, stop, signals (3,4,5,6,11): game/ball.gd (movement, collisions, signals).
  - Score, HUD, game over, restart, quit, input mapping and main scene orchestration (6,7,8,9,10,12,15,16,17,18): game/main.gd (score counter, labels, restart/quit handling, InputMap setup).
  - Scenes: game/main.tscn, game/paddle.tscn, game/ball.tscn hold Node2D roots with attached scripts that implement visuals via draw calls.

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - Main (game/main.gd): owns score:int, game_state:String ("running"/"gameover"), HUD nodes, creates and replaces paddle and ball. Methods:
    - func _on_ball_bounced() -> void
    - func _on_ball_missed() -> void
    - func restart_game() -> void
  - Paddle (game/paddle.gd): owns position:Vector2, size(Vector2), velocity:Vector2, screen_size:Vector2 (set by main). Methods:
    - func squash() -> void (async squash animation)
  - Ball (game/ball.gd): owns position, velocity, radius:float, speed:float, active:bool, screen_size:Vector2 (set by main), paddle:Node (set by main). Signals:
    - signal bounced
    - signal missed
    Methods:
    - func stop() -> void
    - func reset(pos:Vector2) -> void

- Input -> action -> state/rules -> feedback:
  - Inputs configured in main._ready(): "move_left","move_right","restart","quit".
  - Paddle handles movement on _physics_process, prints "MOVE LEFT"/"MOVE RIGHT" on just-pressed, clamps to screen edges (prevents leaving).
  - Ball moves each _physics_process and bounces off left/right/top walls; on paddle collision emits "bounced" (main increments score and prints nothing extra), ball picks spin from paddle.velocity.x, paddle.squash() called.
  - If ball falls below screen, ball emits "missed" (main sets game over, prints "GAME OVER", shows HUD, and calls ball.stop()).
  - Restart (R) prints "RESTART", re-instantiates paddle and ball, score set to 0.
  - Quit (Escape) prints "QUIT" and exits.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Node2D coordinates use top-left origin (0,0) top-left of window; paddle position references its center. Paddle draws rectangle centered on its position. Ball position is center.

- Lifecycle: init(_ready) -> running (ball active) -> on missed => gameover (ball stopped, HUD shown) -> restart resets all state and nodes -> quit exits.

Now I'll write the initial files: __init__.py, project.godot, main.tscn, main.gd. Then run syntax check.

requirement_coverage.check: The game window title displays 'Bounce Keeper'.
Pressing LEFT arrow key moves the paddle left; pressing RIGHT arrow key moves the paddle right.
The paddle's left edge does not go past the left screen edge, and its right edge does not go past the right screen edge.
The ball moves continuously and changes direction upon collision, maintaining a consistent speed unless acted upon by other forces.
When the ball hits the paddle while the paddle is moving, the ball's horizontal velocity component changes based on the paddle's movement direction.
The ball's trajectory changes predictably and realistically after colliding with the paddle or any of the three walls (left, right, top).
When the ball collides with the paddle, the score displayed in the top-left corner increases by 1.
Upon ball collision, the paddle briefly deforms (squashes) and then returns to its original shape.
When the ball's y-coordinate goes below the paddle's bottom edge, the game state changes to 'game over'.
A numerical score is visible in the top-left corner of the screen.
Upon game over, the text 'GAME OVER' appears on screen, along with the final score.
After 'GAME OVER' is displayed, the ball ceases all movement.
After game over, pressing 'R' resets the game, clears the 'GAME OVER' message, sets the score to 0, and the ball resumes movement.
Pressing 'Escape' key closes the game window.
When the LEFT arrow key is pressed, 'MOVE LEFT' is printed to the console.
When the RIGHT arrow key is pressed, 'MOVE RIGHT' is printed to the console.
When the 'R' key is pressed, 'RESTART' is printed to the console.
When the 'Escape' key is pressed, 'QUIT' is printed to the console.
When the game over condition is met, 'GAME OVER' is printed to the console.
